Still required is a uniformly controlled deformation of these global
Fresnel integrals to the rotated saddle boxes of rotated_local_first_loop.md,
including their tails. The periodic nonlinear factor is holomorphic only
on a fixed strip; it cannot simply be rotated along an unbounded complex
ray. A contour that bends and saturates within that strip is a concrete
candidate, but its Jacobians, tail constants and summed orbit-weight loss
must be proved. No such deformation is asserted by (G7).
edits.after:

stated there. The periodic nonlinear factor is not rotated along an
unbounded imaginary ray. This is a separate theorem; (G7) alone does
not supply the deformation or its estimates.
